creativeConstitution.details: Large, persistent, mysterious, living open-world adventure RPG with 2D/isometric presentation and deep simulated world. World continues when player not watching. Player is a person within the world, not the chosen hero.

constraints.details: Do not turn the game into an endless war simulator, RTS, or kingdom-management game. Kingdoms/factions may exist as world systems without war being the main loop.
Never rewrite the engine, create parallel coordinate/chunk systems, or remove working systems. Extend existing architecture.
Do not solve testing problems by teleporting the player or bypassing gameplay. Tests must use real controls.

implementation.summary: Rats in the Cellar quest exists
implementation.details: Quest giver: Mira at Rusty Tankard. Stages: talk-mira, kill-rats (5), return-mira. Rewards: 25 coins, 40 XP, Rat-skin gloves, Bread. Rewards granted at turn-in via completeQuest().

testCoverage.details: 3 runs walking north from spawn, 100 steps each. 0 goats discovered. Goats exist in spawn table (1/5) but not encountered. Possible: insufficient distance, wrong direction, or chunk loading issue. Needs investigation.

decisions.summary: Fixed rat damage pipeline with tile adjacency
decisions.details: Root cause: (1) attackGoat looked up rats in goatsRef not cellarRatsRef, (2) damage gate used 0-100 arc check instead of tile adjacency. Fix: check cellarRatsRef in attackGoat, add cellar-rat to damage gate bypass. Verified: HP 12->3 in browser.

decisions.summary: Goats now spawn in the world
decisions.details: Root cause: goat kind was missing from spawn table. Added goat to kinds array (1/5 chance), mapped to deer sprite. Goats spawn in meadows and wild areas. Starting safe zone preserved.

knownBugs.summary: Cellar rat strikes deal no damage in iso mode
knownBugs.details: Root cause: 1 tile = 8.33 units in 0-100 space, but PLAYER_MELEE_REACH=5. Adjacent tiles are out of range. Fix: tile-based adjacency check implemented in BUILD 571, verification pending.
